paper.title: Pythia: Exploiting Workflow Predictability for Efficient Agent-Native LLM Serving

faithful: workflow profiler / probabilistic finite automaton over a ROLE alphabet
a loop is expressed as a REPEATED role, so the occurrence suffix is dropped
low-probability transition pruning as the bounded probable future
expected remaining DISTANCE (number of future role transitions) from the automaton
completion-aware priority S_completion = 1 / E[D_remaining] with omega1 = 1
adapted: role key composed from role:action_family:raw_action, because the paper's alphabet entry is the current agent_id and a bare VideoSeek role is too coarse
the finite horizon is OUR fixed, train-independent step limit and is NOT the paper's bound, which prunes transitions and applies repetition bounds to looping roles
indexing by the candidate's own role (the agent_id Pythia exposes on a request)

S_unblock is DownstreamIdleRisk over the train-only PFA: SUM over reachable GPU future roles of idle-weight / E[D(current, a)], where idle-weight = sum of P(model|role) over models with zero scheduler-visible ready+running demand
queue-demand PROXY replaces the paper's model-replica queue depth (zero visible demand, not literal replica idleness)
aging is a dimensionless re-score S + lambda*(wait/tau), not the paper's worker loop
deviation: H=6 fixed finite-horizon recursion replaces Pythia's bounded-regex / repetition-bound representation for expected remaining-distance estimation. The paper bounds its automaton with low-probability transition filtering plus repetition bounds on looping roles (engineer^{3,6}); H=6 is our fixed, train-independent approximation.
Algorithm 3's S_unblock uses a queue-demand proxy and a train-only role->model distribution; the paper's literal replica queue and worker aging loop are not reproduced
omissions: cache routing, prefix caching, model-replica idleness, autoscaling
model-replica queue depth: S_unblock uses the scheduler-visible zero-demand proxy
the paper's local-worker aging loop: ours is a dimensionless re-score
defects_closed_before_freeze: template.baseline used as the alphabet, which is not a role alphabet at all
the consumer indexed by the last COMPLETED role while V excludes the role it is indexed by, double-counting the current candidate (80 instead of 60 on A->B->C with 10/20/40)
the finite horizon was described as the paper's bound, which it is not
prohibited_after_freeze: the role alphabet definition, including the dropped occurrence suffix
PFA structure, transition semantics, pruning threshold and renormalisation
the Algorithm 3 base priority (omega1/omega2), aging weight/scale, role_model mapping and the queue-demand proxy
freeze_breaking_exception: A reproducible correctness bug only, recorded as a freeze-breaking fix and never retuned to improve results.
wording_correction: Do not write that the finite horizon replaces a stationary solve: Pythia does not estimate this quantity by solving a stationary system. Write that it replaces the bounded-regex / repetition-bound representation.
variant_rule: Adjusting any of the above requires a NEW VARIANT; it must not overwrite the frozen baseline.

freeze_breaking_fixes.defect: The priority was ranked by a DURATION: the finite-horizon recursion accumulated per-role millisecond means and the live consumer added the candidate's runtime_p50 + load, making the arm a duration-weighted / SRTF-flavoured priority. Pythia Algorithm 3 uses the expected remaining DISTANCE in steps on the probabilistic regex.
freeze_breaking_fixes.fix: V(role) is now the expected NUMBER of future role transitions (a transition to <end> is not a role and is not counted) and S_completion = 1 / (1 + V(role)); the consumer adds no millisecond term. Profiler schema bumped to pythia-role-pfa-v2 so an ms-valued artifact fails closed.
freeze_breaking_fixes.verification: tests/test_pythia_fidelity.py adds test_the_distance_does_not_depend_on_durations and re-derives the chain/fan-out values in steps; 13/13 gate.

V_plus_one_convention: V counts future non-END roles AFTER the current request; therefore D_remaining = 1 + V(current_role).

algorithm3_restoration_20260926.change: Restored the full Algorithm 3 priority omega1*S_completion + omega2*S_unblock plus aging (a first pass used the WRONG distance and a candidate-wise mean; both corrected).
algorithm3_restoration_20260926.S_completion: 1/(1+V(role)), V = expected remaining distance in steps (frozen convention)
algorithm3_restoration_20260926.S_unblock: SUM over PFA-reachable GPU future roles a of idle_weight(a)/E[D(current_role, a)], where idle_weight(a)=sum_m P(m|a)*I[D_m==0]; E[D(current,a)] is the first-hit distance on the pruned PFA (current -> a, NOT a -> terminal)
algorithm3_restoration_20260926.idle_proxy: D_m = count of scheduler-visible ready+running GPU requests for model m, merged across workflows; zero demand = idle-risk
algorithm3_restoration_20260926.role_model: train-only; both the argmax role_model and the full role_model_dist are stored, and S_unblock marginalises over the DISTRIBUTION because purity is low for planner (0.53) and answer_generation (0.50)

frozen_constants.provenance: Data-independent adaptation constants fixed BEFORE formal measurement; values were not selected by optimising formal-evaluation performance, and are frozen henceforth.

non_degeneracy_probe.S_unblock_action_flip_rate: 0/614 decisions: the decision sequence is IDENTICAL with omega2=0 vs omega2=1 (aging off)
non_degeneracy_probe.note: S_unblock is implemented and score-active at the candidate level but OPERATIONALLY INACTIVE on this workload/sample; reported honestly, not tuned. A fidelity freeze does not require it to change the makespan.

sentinels: distance is current->target; nearer idle agent contributes more (D(A,B)=1 < D(A,C)=2)
a recurring role (self-loop) has a POSITIVE first-return distance; no self-loop -> unreachable
raw-sum cardinality: two idle future agents outweigh one
probabilistic deployment mapping is marginalised by P(model|role)
cross-workflow global demand: a model busy elsewhere is not idle-risk
role_model / role_model_dist / role_lane are train-only and validation-invariant
aging monotone in wait and dimensionless
PFA mutation changes the score; a real Template's UNEXECUTED suffix mutation does not
